text:
## Issue-Specific Escalation Paths  
### Customer Complaints  
**Severity: Low (Minor service issue)**
- Initial Handler: Customer Service Staff
- Level: 1–2
- Timeline: 24 hours
- If unresolved: Escalate to Complaints Manager (Level 3)  
**Severity: High (Significant financial loss)**
- Initial Handler: Complaints Manager
- Level: 3–4
- Timeline: 24–48 hours
- Regulatory implication: Notify Compliance
- If >£100k: Board notification  
**Severity: Critical (Regulatory/reputational breach)**
- Initial Handler: Head of Customer Service + Compliance Head
- Level: 4–5
- Timeline: 24 hours
- FCA notification: Within 24 hours (if required)
- Board: Immediate notification

raw_entities.name: Customer Complaint Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: An issue-specific escalation procedure for handling customer complaints across three severity levels (Low, High, Critical), with defined initial handlers, escalation timelines, and regulatory notification requirements. The process routes complaints through escalation levels 1–5 depending on severity, financial impact, and regulatory implications.
context: If unresolved: Escalate to Complaints Manager (Level 3)

raw_entities.name: Initial Complaint Receipt and Severity Assessment
raw_entities.description: The first step in which a complaint is received and classified by severity level (Low, High, or Critical) to determine the appropriate initial handler and escalation pathway.

raw_entities.name: Low Severity Complaint Handling
raw_entities.description: Resolution of minor service issues by Customer Service Staff within 24 hours, with escalation to Complaints Manager (Level 3) if unresolved.

raw_entities.name: High Severity Complaint Handling
raw_entities.description: Resolution of significant financial loss complaints by Complaints Manager within 24–48 hours, with Compliance notification and Board notification if loss exceeds £100k.

raw_entities.name: Critical Severity Complaint Handling
raw_entities.description: Immediate handling of regulatory or reputational breaches by Head of Customer Service and Compliance Head within 24 hours, with mandatory FCA notification and immediate Board escalation.
context: Initial Handler: Head of Customer Service + Compliance Head

raw_entities.name: Compliance Notification
raw_entities.description: Notification of Compliance function when a High Severity complaint involves regulatory implications, ensuring regulatory oversight of complaint resolution.

raw_entities.name: Board Notification for High-Value Loss
raw_entities.description: Escalation to Board when a High Severity complaint involves financial loss exceeding £100k, ensuring executive awareness of material financial impact.

raw_entities.name: FCA Notification
raw_entities.description: Notification to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) within 24 hours when a Critical Severity complaint involves regulatory requirements, ensuring compliance with regulatory notification obligations.

raw_entities.name: Immediate Board Notification for Critical Issues
raw_entities.description: Immediate notification to the Board when a Critical Severity complaint is identified, ensuring executive awareness of regulatory or reputational breaches.

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Staff
raw_entities.description: The frontline role responsible for receiving and initially handling Low Severity complaints within 24 hours, with authority to resolve minor service issues or escalate to Complaints Manager.

raw_entities.name: Complaints Manager
raw_entities.description: The escalation point for unresolved Low Severity complaints and the initial handler for High Severity complaints, responsible for resolution within 24–48 hours and coordination with Compliance.
context: If unresolved: Escalate to Complaints Manager (Level 3)

raw_entities.name: Head of Customer Service
raw_entities.description: Senior leadership role jointly responsible with Compliance Head for handling Critical Severity complaints involving regulatory or reputational breaches, with authority to escalate to Board and FCA.
context: Initial Handler: Head of Customer Service + Compliance Head

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: Senior compliance leadership role jointly responsible with Head of Customer Service for handling Critical Severity complaints, ensuring regulatory compliance and coordinating FCA notification.
context: Initial Handler: Head of Customer Service + Compliance Head

raw_entities.name: Compliance Function
raw_entities.description: The compliance function notified when High Severity complaints have regulatory implications, responsible for ensuring regulatory oversight and compliance with notification obligations.

raw_entities.name: Board
raw_entities.description: The Board receives notification when High Severity complaints involve financial loss exceeding £100k and receives immediate notification for all Critical Severity complaints.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority
raw_entities.description: The external regulatory authority notified within 24 hours when Critical Severity complaints involve regulatory requirements, as mandated by regulatory obligations.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Severity Classification
raw_entities.description: The initial decision point that classifies a complaint as Low, High, or Critical severity, determining the appropriate initial handler, escalation level, timeline, and regulatory notification requirements.

raw_entities.name: Low Severity Resolution Check
raw_entities.description: A decision point at 24 hours to determine whether a Low Severity complaint has been resolved by Customer Service Staff or requires escalation to Complaints Manager (Level 3).
context: If unresolved: Escalate to Complaints Manager (Level 3)

raw_entities.name: Financial Loss Threshold Check
raw_entities.description: A decision point for High Severity complaints to determine whether financial loss exceeds £100k, triggering mandatory Board notification.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Notification Requirement Check
raw_entities.description: A decision point for Critical Severity complaints to determine whether regulatory notification to the FCA is required within 24 hours.

raw_entities.name: Level 1 — Customer Service Staff Resolution
raw_entities.description: The frontline escalation level for Low Severity complaints, handled by Customer Service Staff with a 24-hour resolution timeline.

raw_entities.name: Level 2 — Customer Service Staff Escalation
raw_entities.description: The second escalation level for Low Severity complaints, still within Customer Service Staff authority, before escalation to Complaints Manager.

raw_entities.name: Level 3 — Complaints Manager Resolution
raw_entities.description: The escalation point for unresolved Low Severity complaints and the initial level for High Severity complaints, handled by Complaints Manager with 24–48 hour timeline and Compliance notification.
context: If unresolved: Escalate to Complaints Manager (Level 3)

raw_entities.name: Level 4 — Senior Management Resolution
raw_entities.description: The escalation level for High Severity complaints and initial level for Critical Severity complaints, involving senior management with 24–48 hour timeline for High Severity and 24 hours for Critical.

raw_entities.name: Level 5 — Executive and Regulatory Escalation
raw_entities.description: The highest escalation level for Critical Severity complaints, involving Head of Customer Service and Compliance Head with 24-hour timeline, immediate Board notification, and FCA notification within 24 hours.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Originator
raw_entities.description: The customer who initiates a complaint regarding a service issue, financial loss, or regulatory/reputational breach, triggering the complaint resolution process.
